grammar_distinctions_required_by_CH_B: Old frozen P-control membership must remain distinct from Grammar-v0 P_in/P_out interface direction.
O carrier membership must remain distinct from a directed/function-valued rho relation.
Pi must admit non-physical role, nested-role, processing-stage, information-type and subsystem individuation where explicitly frozen.
C must remain realizability/admissibility-like and must not absorb generic condition nodes.
Q must admit criterion satisfaction, optimization/value-cost orientation, uncertainty comparison and cycle-specific selection without a scalar-only assumption.
K must admit relational, higher-arity and cross-role dependence/transformation without requiring T.
T must remain separate from K and retain index/range/recurrence/ordering structure.
Persistence requires explicit typed carry/transport support before compression into K-over-T.
Roles may overlap on one frozen node, as in CH12 limited_interface_states (X+C) and interface_update_or_request (O + partial P_in).
roles_not_needed_by_CH_B: P_out is not structurally required by any of the six frozen CH-B claims.
A deterministic/function-valued K specialization is not required.

CH10 already-frozen approximation residual requires simultaneous approximate internal valuation and stochastic final action sampling; Grammar v0 does not repair that claim-language distinction.

CH08/CH10 persistence lacks explicit carry/transport witnesses.
CH12 direct-bypass topology is acknowledged but endpoints/edges are not frozen strongly enough to project as an extra K edge.
